Day 2: Sardinia Logistics, Island Rhythm & Flight Passenger Rights

Morning – ARST Regional Bus Corridor (Via Carlo Felice 08:17)

To truly understand the Mediterranean outside tourist bubbles, take the morning ARST regional service along Via Carlo Felice towards Sanluri. This transit corridor connects local agricultural hubs, medieval stone castles, and quiet countryside landscapes.

Afternoon – What to Do If Your Flight Home Is Delayed (EC 261 Law)

European air passenger regulations (EC 261/2004) are the strongest in the world. If your return flight back to the UK, Gulf, or Northern Europe is delayed by more than 3 hours, you are legally entitled to up to 600€ in cash compensation directly from the airline.
